diagnostic_definition.candidate: Highest same-class reference IoU among retained predictions; lower prediction index breaks ties.
diagnostic_definition.candidate_reuse: Diagnostic candidates may be reused or already assigned to another reference; this is not the official one-to-one matcher.
diagnostic_definition.distance_scope: Unnormalized descriptive distance; no NWD normalization constant, training objective or evaluation replacement is selected.
diagnostic_definition.near_overlap_miss: An officially unmatched reference with 0.30 <= maximum retained-prediction IoU < 0.50.
diagnostic_definition.physical_identity: Overlap does not establish that the candidate depicts the same physical front.
diagnostic_definition.ratio_flags: Width or height ratio strictly above 1.50 is descriptive only; continuous values are preserved.
diagnostic_definition.signed_edges: Prediction minus reference, in original 1280x720 image pixels; x rightward and y downward.
diagnostic_definition.zero_overlap: No candidate is selected when every retained prediction has zero overlap.

protocol.comparison: Supplied detector weights versus trained detector plus equal corner averaging, with common processing.
protocol.scores: Original-view detector scores retained for comparison; not calibrated for averaged coordinates.
